_comment: Hard rules enforced pre-publish on every scan. Source of truth — NOT editorial. tools/validate-scan.js asserts these against scanner/YYYYMMDD/signals.json before publication.
_provenance: Encoded from scanner/CLAUDE.md + retrospective learnings (Apr 6 INDO dilution, Mar 27 stop tightness, Mar 13 EU FX headwind, Feb 27 Short Squeeze 0% WR).

strategies._reason: Short Squeeze: 0% WR over Feb-Mar (retros). Other forbidden labels = invented variants that bypass sweep optimization.

tickers._reason: Below $500M mcap = dilution + manipulation risk (INDO incident Apr 6). Below $10M ADV = liquidity trap, can't exit at scale.

tkl_pool._comment: TKL pool = small/mid-cap momentum. Relaxed thresholds but SAME validation pipeline as top 10 (anti-dilution, earnings, insiders, options, sharia).
tkl_pool._reason: TKL targets small-caps by design. $10M mcap floor avoids penny stocks. $2M ADV ensures basic liquidity. All other filters (dilution, earnings ±3d, sharia) apply identically.

dilution_blocklist._comment: Underwriters known for serial dilution / toxic financing. Block tickers whose recent 424B/S-3 includes any of these names.
dilution_blocklist._reason: Pattern: small-cap with toxic underwriter + recent S-3 = 80%+ probability of dilution event within next 30 days.

sharia._comment: AAOIFI / MSCI Islamic Index thresholds. Used to tag data-sharia and filter when --sharia mode is active.

anti_duplicate._comment: Never enter a second position on a ticker already open in any portfolio mode.

regime_labels._reason: Stable taxonomy. No 'DEEP RISK-OFF', no 'STRONG RISK-ON', no inventions.

earnings_window._reason: TimesFM directional accuracy drops to 40% within ±3d of earnings vs 56% baseline. Setups are unreliable.

candlestick._comment: Trading filter for candlestick/bull signals. Detection uses 1.0x (like Go ab-scan-history). Trading uses 8.0x (like Go portfolio config). sweep.js checks this when simulating candlestick trades.
candlestick._reason: Matches systematic-tss portfolio_us_americanbulls.yaml min_vol_ratio: 8.0. Separates detection (all patterns) from trading (high-conviction only).

stops._reason: Mar 27 retro: stops < 1.5x ATR triggered intraday before recovery on 3 setups. Floor at 3% absolute.

overextension._comment: Block parabolic / late-stage setups. Encoded from VRT failure May 18 (entry $367 → SL $336 same-day, -7.9% on AI-leader sell-off). VRT was +27% in 6 weeks, +38% above 50-DMA, RSI > 75 — pure narrative momentum with no technical health.
overextension._consolidation_def: For Momentum/Breakout: require >=5 bars where high-low range < 1.5xATR before the trade. Marche-d'escalier verticale (every bar a new high) = parabolic exhaustion risk.
overextension._pullback_special: Pullback strategy can be at OR below 50-DMA (negative distance OK). Cap above is +5% to avoid double-counting Momentum setups labeled as Pullback.
overextension._reason: VRT was 38% above 50-DMA with no consolidation = textbook 3-sigma reversal risk. AMAT similar profile (post-16-analyst-raise cluster, also crashed -5.28% same day). Capping distance + requiring consolidation rejects these traps.

diversification._reason: Avoid '3 techs in same week' concentration. Sector cap from risk overlay.

scan_size._reason: Design = top-10 per strategy (momentum/breakout/pullback) + combined pool, up to ~40 editorial candidates. Prior exact:10 was stale — a curated-selection cap mis-applied to the raw candidate pool.

score_limits._comment: Score validation gates — added 2026-06-30 after war room found scoring ceiling bug (6/11 signals at 100, R:R uniformity 11/11 at 1:2.1).
score_limits._reason: Perfect 100 scores indicate pass/fail composite ceiling bug. >50% signals at 95+ in ERO is statistically impossible. Identical R:R on >60% signals means TP is reverse-engineered from fixed R:R, not computed from technicals.

regime_strategy_gates._comment: Strategy caps per regime — added 2026-06-30 after 4 Pullback signals in ERO violated lesson pullback-regime-confidence-gate.
regime_strategy_gates._reason: ERO lesson: Pullback blocked below 60% regime confidence + max 1 in ERO. Breakout 0% WR in ERO across 3+ retros. Momentum capped per regime-score-label-lag rule.

vix_kill_switch._comment: Regime-based position sizing. Applied in tools/sweep.js via regimeSizeMultiplier(). Halves drawdown during stress episodes.
vix_kill_switch._reason: Feb-Mar retros showed -40% of drawdown came from risk-off scan dates. Halving exposure cuts tail risk without sacrificing bull-run performance.

event_driven._comment: Source of truth for the event-driven scanners (PEAD / filings / gap). Read by tools/{gap,pead,filings}-scanner.js + sweep.js. SIM-ONLY: signal generation + simulated perf only, never an order. Thresholds encoded from docs/specs/event-driven-scanners.md (§2.1 PEAD, §2.2 filings, §2.3 gap, §2.0 shared gates).
event_driven._gap_reason: spec §2.3: gap >= +4% vs prev close, premarket volume >= 3x normal (calibratable default, re-tune from gap RunBacktest baseline), dollar-volume >= $1M + price >= $5 penny reject, earnings gaps route to pead_pool (dedup, one ticker never in two pools).

insider_cluster._reason: spec §2.2: cluster-buy long idea is US-only (no EU PDMR feed via MCP — never fabricate an EU insider signal). >=2 distinct insiders, code P (Purchase), net-buyer within 30d. min_net_usd is a calibratable default; re-tune from the insider event-study baseline before promoting filings past draft. Zero fabrication (MCP hard-stop) — pool absent if staging MCP fails, never estimated.

pead._reason: spec §2.1: gap held >= +3% at print, confirmation volume >= 1.5x avg20, EMA20 extension <= 8% (drift still ahead), EPS beat + guidance raised mandatory (guidance up = A+ discriminant), >=5 consecutive beats = quality streak. Data via MCP only (earnings_quarterly/analyst_actions/technicals).

stops._reason: spec §2.0 shared gates — stop in [3%,8%] and >= 1.5x ATR14. Mirrored from the canonical top-level 'stops' block for event-driven scanners; keep in sync, do not diverge.

rr_min_by_regime._comment: R/R floor per regime. Reuses the regime_labels.allowed taxonomy (no new labels invented). spec §2.1/§2.3: >= 1.5 in RISK-ON/NEUTRAL, >= 2.0 in EARLY RISK-OFF/RISK-OFF.
